Conversation Time: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023. Caroline: Hey Melanie! How's it going? I wanted to tell you about my school event last week. It was awesome! Conversations about gender identity and inclusion are so necessary and I'm thankful for being able to give a voice to the trans community. Thank you for using your voice to create love, acceptance, and hope. You're doing amazing! Caroline: Your words mean a lot to me. I'm grateful for the chance to share my story and give others hope.
